newsitem.title: USA: Zurn Industries Q3 continuing oper shr up.
newsitem.headline: Zurn Industries Q3 continuing oper shr up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note: Zurn Industries Inc reported its ernings per share from continuing operations were $0.39 in 1996's third quarter against $0.36 for the same period in 1995. For the nine-month periods, earnings per share from continuing operations were $1.36 in 1996 and $1.13 in 1995.

The company reported continuing operations income of $4.9 million in the third quarter of 1996 against $4.4 million in the same period of 1995. In the nine-month period continuing operations income totaled $16.9 million against $13.9 million for the same period in 1995.
Data for 1995 has been restated for the effects of the decision to discontinue the power systems segment businesses. Periods ended Dec 31.
